review.visualFinding: The image shows the inner moat, stone walls and covered Saya bridge from the keep-foundation observation deck. Modern city buildings are incidental in the background. It is not a photograph of a surviving castle keep. This replaced the private first-preview outer-wall photograph dominated by railway tracks.
